cues.text: An empty hall. White flowers bank a stage around Shinjiro's portrait.
Akihiko walks down the aisle and up to the altar.
He kneels, head down on his arms against the flowers.
His Persona appears: a muscled giant with long golden hair.
It becomes a robed figure with a dark face, holding a sword and a globe.
Akihiko stands alone before the portrait.
